question: What participating systems had better results than ones authors submitted?

answer.free_form_answer:
For SLC task : Ituorp, ProperGander and YMJA  teams had better results.
For FLC task: newspeak and Antiganda teams had better results.

title: Neural Architectures for Fine-Grained Propaganda Detection in News
answer_short: Systems ranked 1st and 2nd in each task
answer_rationale: The MIC-CIS system ranked 3rd and 4th in FLC and SLC tasks respectively, indicating that systems ranked 1st and 2nd in each task outperformed it. This is directly supported by the text stating MIC-CIS ranked 3rd and 4th compared to other participating systems.
